zoe_m: quick heads-up: after PTQ bringup of small-reranker-v3 we see a 1.9% NDCG drop but only on queries <8 tokens.

rafael_b: is this pure quant noise or did any preprocessing change?

zoe_m: weights identical. difference: we switched to a compact serializer and a faster PTQ path that strips ZERO-WIDTH JOINER (ZWJ) for size.

inkey_c: ZWJ removal can change BPE boundaries for short queries with emoji or ligatures. any example diffs?

zoe_m: yes — sample: "Café" vs "Cafe" ended up with different token ids after strip. small queries are high-signal so ranker margin collapses.

rafael_b: that aligns. PTQ amplifies tiny logit shifts. mitigation: stop stripping ZWJ in serializer and add a token-parity smoke in pre-commit.

build-bot: CI run 9123: rerank-ptq-smoke FAILED (ndcg-short-slice). logs: https://ci.internal/9123

zoe_m: pushed serializer revert and a unit test comparing token ids for 1000 short-query samples.

inkey_c: re-run looks good locally: NDCG back to baseline +/-0.1%. I'll queue the CI rerun.

rafael_b: add an onboarding note: "avoid unicode normalization that changes grapheme clusters without explicit test".

build-bot: Created issue RINF-7899 and requeued CI job 9124."
